tasks.title: Update CLAUDE.md
tasks.description:
Update CLAUDE.md to reflect the TypeScript-only architecture:

- Entry point is now src/index.ts, compiled to dist/ralph via 'bun run build'
- Remove all references to bin/ralph as entry point
- Update execution flow: src/index.ts uses Commander to dispatch to src/commands/*.ts
- Update architecture section: lib/ only contains Python narration scripts (ralph_narrate.py, ralph_narrate_server.py)
- Remove mentions of shell fallback, RALPH_FORCE_SHELL, forceShellFallback
- Remove references to shell scripts (ralph_common.sh, ralph_config.sh, etc.) as active code
- Update file structure / per-project data layout if needed
- Update conventions section: no more 'set -euo pipefail', no more RALPH_LIB_DIR for shell compat
- Update the Development section: install.sh now runs bun build, mention 'bun test' for running tests
- Keep the section accurate — read the current CLAUDE.md first and make targeted updates

tasks.title: Full test suite + build verification
tasks.description:
Run the full verification suite to confirm everything works after the shell-to-TS cutover:

1. Run 'bun test' — all tests must pass (expect 601+ tests)
2. Run 'bun run build' — must compile cleanly to dist/ralph
3. Run './dist/ralph --version' — must print version string

If any tests fail, investigate and fix the root cause. Common issues:
- Tests that reference deleted files (ralph_common.sh, fallback.ts)
- Tests that check for RALPH_FORCE_SHELL behavior
- Tests that assert specific command counts including fallback commands
- Import errors from removed modules

Do NOT skip or delete failing tests — fix them or the code they test.
